# Evidence Span

An anchored target span within a resource — a text quote, character position, fragment identifier, page, or generic locator. Generalized from the citation-selector model to serve both evidentiary claims (#54/#55) and annotation targets (#63). The selector properties (selectorTextQuote, selectorTextPosition, selectorPage, selectorLocator) are asserted on EvidenceSpan individuals and inherited by Selector instances. No second selector model is minted (Principle 4).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EvidenceSpan>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:EvidenceSpan`  

**Subclass of:** `gmeow:InformationObject`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/evidence>
